$comment: This schema only shapes the settings form in the plugin manager. It is NOT a validation boundary: every value is still parsed and clamped by the plugin code at runtime, so an out-of-range, missing or malformed value degrades gracefully instead of stopping the plugin from loading.

x-description-i18n.en: Plugin enablement and automatic startup.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 插件的启用与自动启动。

enabled.title: Enable plugin
enabled.description: When off, the plugin does not run at all.

x-description-i18n.en: When off, the plugin does not run at all.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 关闭后插件完全不再运行。

auto_start.title: Start automatically
auto_start.description: Run automatically when the plugin system starts, without starting it by hand each time.

x-description-i18n.en: Run automatically when the plugin system starts, without starting it by hand each time.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 插件系统启动时自动运行，不用每次手动点启动。

agent_deskmate.title: Neko Deskmate
agent_deskmate.description: Settings for observation, broadcasts and approvals.

x-description-i18n.en: Settings for observation, broadcasts and approvals.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 观测、播报与审批的相关设置。

coalesce_seconds.title: Broadcast merge window (seconds)
coalesce_seconds.description: The same event is announced only once within this window, to avoid flooding the chat.

x-description-i18n.en: The same event is announced only once within this window, to avoid flooding the chat.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 同一件事在这个时间内只播一次，防止刷屏。

log_commands.title: Keep command text in logs
log_commands.description: Off by default: logs keep only the command length and its first few characters. Either way, secrets are masked before anything is written.

x-description-i18n.en: Off by default: logs keep only the command length and its first few characters. Either way, secrets are masked before anything is written.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 默认关闭：日志只记命令长度和前几十个字；两种情况都会先给敏感信息打码。

watch.title: Observation sources
watch.description: Where the plugin reads session records from. Supports ~ and environment variables.

x-description-i18n.en: Where the plugin reads session records from. Supports ~ and environment variables.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 插件从哪里读会话记录。支持 ~ 和环境变量。

claude_projects_dir.title: Claude Code records directory
claude_projects_dir.description: Directory that holds the session records, as jsonl files.

x-description-i18n.en: Directory that holds the session records, as jsonl files.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 存放会话记录的目录，里面是 jsonl 文件。

cc_switch_db.title: Gateway ledger file
cc_switch_db.description: The cc-switch database file. Opened read-only.

x-description-i18n.en: The cc-switch database file. Opened read-only.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: cc-switch 的数据库文件，只读打开。

mine.title: Sessions you started
mine.description: Sessions you started yourself inside these directories. This decides how broadcasts are worded; if nothing is declared, everything is treated as unknown.

x-description-i18n.en: Sessions you started yourself inside these directories. This decides how broadcasts are worded; if nothing is declared, everything is treated as unknown.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 你亲自在这些目录下开过的会话。用来决定播报怎么说；不声明就全部按未知处理。

roots.title: Directory list
roots.description: One directory per entry. Sessions inside them are announced as started by you.

x-description-i18n.en: One directory per entry. Sessions inside them are announced as started by you.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 每项一个目录。落在里面的会话，播报会说「你自己开的」。

progress.title: Progress and failure alerts
progress.description: How long counts as "something is wrong" when the agent goes quiet, loops, or fails. These only change when and how often you are told; they never affect approvals or any safety decision.

x-description-i18n.en: How long counts as "something is wrong" when the agent goes quiet, loops, or fails. These only change when and how often you are told; they never affect approvals or any safety decision.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 它安静了、兜圈子了、失败了，多久算「不对劲」。这些值只改变你什么时候被告知、多常被告知，不影响审批，也不影响任何安全判断。

wait_escalate_seconds.title: Ask again after (seconds)
wait_escalate_seconds.description: When the agent stops and waits for you, the first reminder is immediate; this sets how long until it asks a second time.

x-description-i18n.en: When the agent stops and waits for you, the first reminder is immediate; this sets how long until it asks a second time.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 它停下来等你的时候，第一次会马上说；这里设定再过多久提醒第二次。

unclosed_action_seconds.title: No reply for (seconds)
unclosed_action_seconds.description: An action that has not come back within this long counts as stuck, and is announced.

x-description-i18n.en: An action that has not come back within this long counts as stuck, and is announced.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 一个动作发出去这么久还没结果，就算它卡住了，会播报。

boundary_round_seconds.title: Quiet gap that ends a round (seconds)
boundary_round_seconds.description: When two rounds are this far apart, the earlier round is considered finished, and actions still waiting there stop counting as stuck.

x-title-i18n.en: Quiet gap that ends a round (seconds)
x-title-i18n.zh-CN: 多长的安静算一轮结束（秒）

x-description-i18n.en: When two rounds are this far apart, the earlier round is considered finished, and actions still waiting there stop counting as stuck.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 两轮之间安静这么久就算上一轮结束了；那一轮里还没回包的动作不再算卡住。

fail_coalesce_seconds.title: Same failure not repeated within (seconds)
fail_coalesce_seconds.description: The same failure is not announced again inside this window.

x-title-i18n.zh-CN: 同一个失败多久内不重复说（秒）

x-description-i18n.en: The same failure is not announced again inside this window.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 同一个失败在这个时间内不重复播报。

failure_confirm_seconds.title: Wait before reporting a failure (seconds)
failure_confirm_seconds.description: After a failure, wait this long for it to recover on its own before saying anything. Measured: most failures recover within a quarter of a minute, so waiting here removes most false alarms. Set 0 to be told immediately.

x-description-i18n.en: After a failure, wait this long for it to recover on its own before saying anything. Measured: most failures recover within a quarter of a minute, so waiting here removes most false alarms. Set 0 to be told immediately.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 失败之后等这么久，它要是自己好了就不打扰你。实测九成以上的失败在一分钟内自己恢复，所以等这一下能挡掉绝大多数假警报。设 0 表示立刻说。

approval.title: Approvals
approval.description: How you are asked, and how decisions are made, when permission is needed.

x-description-i18n.en: How you are asked, and how decisions are made, when permission is needed.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 需要权限时怎么问你怎么决定。

port.title: Local service port
port.description: Listens on this machine only. After changing it, re-install the approval link once from the authorization entry.

x-description-i18n.en: Listens on this machine only. After changing it, re-install the approval link once from the authorization entry.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 只听本机。改完之后要去授权入口重装一次审批连接。

timeout_mark_expired.title: Time to wait for a decision (seconds)
timeout_mark_expired.description: Past this time with no decision, the request counts as undecided; the plugin never decides for you. Must be below 600.

x-title-i18n.en: Time to wait for a decision (seconds)

x-description-i18n.en: Past this time with no decision, the request counts as undecided; the plugin never decides for you. Must be below 600.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 超过这个时间没有人决定，这条就视为未决定——插件不替你决定。必须小于 600。

retention_seconds.title: Record retention (seconds)
retention_seconds.description: How long expired approval records are kept, so they can still be looked up afterwards.

x-description-i18n.en: How long expired approval records are kept, so they can still be looked up afterwards.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 过期的审批记录保留多久，供事后查。

ai_judgement.title: Enable model suggestions
ai_judgement.description: After turning this on you also need to fill in the model settings below and confirm once in the authorization entry. Without that confirmation no suggestion is shown.

x-description-i18n.en: After turning this on you also need to fill in the model settings below and confirm once in the authorization entry. Without that confirmation no suggestion is shown.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 打开后还要填好下面的模型信息，并且去授权入口确认一次；不确认的话建议不会出现。

auto_decide.title: Auto-approval scope
auto_decide.description: Off: you decide every time. Low risk only: low-risk actions may be approved automatically, high-risk ones still need you every time, and nothing is ever refused automatically.

x-description-i18n.en: Off: you decide every time. Low risk only: low-risk actions may be approved automatically, high-risk ones still need you every time, and nothing is ever refused automatically.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 关闭：每次都由你点。仅低风险：低风险动作可以自动放行，高风险仍然每次都要你点，任何时候都不会自动拒绝。

auto_decide_max_severity.title: Highest risk allowed for auto-approval
auto_decide_max_severity.description: Four levels from low to high. Even the top level does not auto-approve high-risk actions; that layer is not governed by this option.

x-description-i18n.en: Four levels from low to high. Even the top level does not auto-approve high-risk actions; that layer is not governed by this option.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 从低到高四档。开到最高也不会自动放行高风险动作——那一层不归这个选项管。

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Key used to call the model. Empty means no model is connected. It is never shown in logs, cards or any echo.

x-description-i18n.en: Key used to call the model. Empty means no model is connected. It is never shown in logs, cards or any echo.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 调用模型用的密钥。留空表示不接入模型。不会显示在日志、卡片或任何回显里。

explain_verbosity.title: Detail level for explanations
explain_verbosity.description: How much the What-is-this card explains. Brief: only the conclusion and the worst outcome. Standard: adds the scope and the rule verdict. Detailed: also adds the model's reason and the evidence it cited.

x-description-i18n.en: How much the What-is-this card explains. Brief: only the conclusion and the worst outcome. Standard: adds the scope and the rule verdict. Detailed: also adds the model's reason and the evidence it cited.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 点「这是什么」时讲多细。简短：只讲结论和最坏结果。标准：再加上影响范围和规则判断。详细：再叠加模型给的理由和依据。

broadcast_speak.title: Broadcast style
broadcast_speak.description: false (default) = ai_behavior blind, plain text only, the character stays silent. true = respond, the main model takes a turn for every broadcast and restates it in her own words. It does NOT guarantee voice: whether that turn is spoken aloud depends on whether character voice is enabled in N.E.K.O. Cannot be turned on without an API key, because respond needs a model turn.

x-description-i18n.en: false (default) = ai_behavior blind, plain text only, the character stays silent. true = respond, the main model takes a turn for every broadcast and restates it in her own words. It does NOT guarantee voice: whether that turn is spoken aloud depends on whether character voice is enabled in N.E.K.O. Cannot be turned on without an API key, because respond needs a model turn.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: false（默认）= ai_behavior blind，只出文字，角色不开口。true = respond，每条播报让主模型接一轮，用角色自己的话复述。它不保证语音：那一轮话会不会被念出来，取决于在 N.E.K.O 里有没有开角色语音。没配 API key 时不能开——respond 需要主模型接一轮。

warning_emphasis.title: High-risk warning emphasis
warning_emphasis.description: How loudly the high-risk warning is shown. First few times: the full red line for the first few requests of each kind, then a small badge. Always: the red line every time. Never: only the badge. This only changes how the warning looks, never whether a request can be allowed automatically.

x-title-i18n.zh-CN: 高风险警示的强调程度

x-description-i18n.en: How loudly the high-risk warning is shown. First few times: the full red line for the first few requests of each kind, then a small badge. Always: the red line every time. Never: only the badge. This only changes how the warning looks, never whether a request can be allowed automatically.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 高风险警示显示得多醒目。前几次：同一类操作的前几次显示整行红字，之后缩成一个徽标。每次：每次都显示整行红字。从不：只显示徽标。这只改变警示长什么样，不改变任何操作能不能被自动放行——高危操作始终必须你亲自点。

warning_first_n.title: How many times to show the full red line
warning_first_n.description: Only used when the emphasis above is set to the first few times. The full red line appears for the first N requests of each kind; after that it becomes a small badge.

x-title-i18n.en: How many times to show the full red line

x-description-i18n.en: Only used when the emphasis above is set to the first few times. The full red line appears for the first N requests of each kind; after that it becomes a small badge.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 只在上面的强调程度选「前几次」时有效。同一类操作的前 N 次显示整行红字，第 N+1 次起缩成一个徽标。

model.title: Model
model.description: Which model to connect. The model only advises; it never decides for you.

x-description-i18n.en: Which model to connect. The model only advises; it never decides for you.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 接入哪个模型。模型只给建议，永远不替你决定。

protocol.title: Interface type
protocol.description: Two request formats. Pick the one your provider expects.

x-description-i18n.en: Two request formats. Pick the one your provider expects.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 两种请求格式，按你用的服务商要求选。

base_url.title: Interface address
base_url.description: Root address of the service, without a trailing path.

x-description-i18n.en: Root address of the service, without a trailing path.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 服务的根地址，末尾不要带路径。

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: The same key as in the approval section; this one takes precedence. It is never shown in logs, cards or any echo.

x-description-i18n.en: The same key as in the approval section; this one takes precedence. It is never shown in logs, cards or any echo.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 与审批那一栏填的是同一个东西，这里优先。不会显示在日志、卡片或任何回显里。

model.title: Model name
model.description: Name of the model to call.

x-description-i18n.en: Name of the model to call.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 要调用的模型名。

auto_review.title: Automatic review (experimental, off by default)
auto_review.description: Let a model classify each request from four narrow inputs, and auto-allow only when it says low risk plus allow. The same switch also suppresses warn/notice broadcasts the model calls not worth mentioning. Critical never goes to review, and any failure broadcasts as usual. Off by default and needs its own authorization.

x-title-i18n.zh-CN: 自动审查档（实验性，默认关）

x-description-i18n.en: Let a model classify each request from four narrow inputs, and auto-allow only when it says low risk plus allow. Off by default and needs its own authorization.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 让模型只看四类窄输入后给出风险分类，只在其判「低风险且允许」时替你放行。同一个开关还管「播报压制」：它判不值一提的【警告】/【提示】不再播。【严重】永远不送审，任何失败一律照旧播。默认关，且需单独签字。

enabled.title: Enable automatic review
enabled.description: Off by default. Turning it on is not enough on its own: the separate authorization must also be confirmed.

x-description-i18n.en: Off by default. Turning it on is not enough on its own: the separate authorization must also be confirmed.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 默认关。光改成 true 还不够，还要单独确认授权。

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: openai or anthropic. Leave empty to reuse the model section.

x-description-i18n.en: openai or anthropic. Leave empty to reuse the model section.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: openai 或 anthropic。留空则复用模型那一节的设置。

base_url.description: Leave empty to reuse the model section.

x-description-i18n.en: Leave empty to reuse the model section.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 留空则复用模型那一节的设置。

api_key.description: Leave empty to reuse the model section. Never echoed back.

x-description-i18n.en: Leave empty to reuse the model section. Never echoed back.
x-description-i18n.zh-CN: 留空则复用模型那一节的设置。永不回显。

model.description: Leave empty to reuse the model section.
